verdict.rationale: All evidence shows Radar is deeply integrated into Stripe's own payment processing stack (Stripe charges, Stripe Dashboard, Stripe test cards) with no mention of support for other PSPs, gateways, or platforms; a community comment even notes 'there is no good competition,' implying lock-in rather than portability. No evidence supports multi-PSP or cross-platform use, so the story is unmet despite being a fair question for a fraud-detection product.
